$description: Tier 3: the VHS box posters on Discover's grid (design approved 2026-10-09): each film drawn as a 3D cardboard video sleeve. The art, the genre band on the spine and the cassette's label sticker take the film's genre tone at runtime (`--tone`).

card.$description: Raw card on the folded top and bottom edges, the rubbed shelf wear, the barcode label

ink.$description: Printing on the card: the year band, the label sticker, the barcode

shell.$description: The dark printed spine and the black cassette in the open end

light.$description: Title text on the spine, and the light that tints the cassette
